day: Day 1: Arrival in Delhi & Travel to Manali
activities: Morning: Arrive in Delhi and relax for a while.
Afternoon: Begin your journey to Manali by private vehicle or take an overnight Volvo bus.
Evening: Overnight journey to Manali (if traveling by bus or car).
Morning: Reach Manali in the morning, check into your hotel, and freshen up.
Afternoon: Take a leisurely walk around Mall Road, explore local shops, cafes, and the beautiful surroundings.
Evening: Relax and enjoy dinner at a local restaurant.

day: Day 3: Solang Valley and Rohtang Pass
activities: Morning: Head to Solang Valley for adventure activities such as paragliding, zorbing, or skiing.
Afternoon: Visit the famous Rohtang Pass (open seasonally), offering stunning views and snow activities.
Evening: Return to Manali and relax.
Morning: Visit Hadimba Temple, a peaceful and scenic spot nestled in the forest.
Afternoon: Explore Manu Temple, or visit Vashisht Baths for a rejuvenating hot spring bath.
Evening: Stroll along the Beas River or visit Old Manali for a relaxed vibe.
Morning: After breakfast, check out of your hotel and travel back to Delhi.
Evening: Arrive in Delhi by evening/night, and your trip concludes.
